title: pulse (revisit, case study)
subtitle: b2b financial dashboard for secure cross-border transactions, supporting huge batch of transactions

generalStatements: unlike commercial transactions where only a little amount is required, there is a need to facilitate organisations' huge transactions across the world. due to complications especially with security and regulatory hurdles, this platform assists with overcoming them, providing a smooth cross-border transaction.
we created a platform to facilitate this, but looking back, there are a few problems. one highlight is especially on batch payment system. thus, for this case study...
projectStatements.mainStatement: how can we optimise multi-currency batch payment system to cut transaction time?
